name: CALET
summary: Space cosmic-ray calorimeter involving Japan, the United States, Italy and other partners. TeV electron spectra and gamma-ray observations search for dark-matter features and study nearby astrophysical sources.
detection_principle: A charge detector, imaging calorimeter and deep absorption calorimeter measure charge, direction and energy; shower shapes separate electrons from hadrons.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
